dag_infos.description: New Taipei City mortality rates by sex and single age from MOI RIS ODRP117. The source age is single-year (with the final 100+ open group), so ages 18-35 are exact; mortality rates are retained and never summed.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市人口死亡率（按性別及單一年齡）
data_infos.source_type: 內政部戶政司 RIS OpenData API (ODRP117)
data_infos.dataset_description: 各縣市人口死亡率按性別及單一年齡分。本DAG只取新北市（來源代碼65000000，契約統一為65000）及民國113至114。死亡率單位為每千人，來源最後一格100代表100歲以上。
data_infos.etl_description: Probe ROC years with RIS response codes; HTTP 200 plus OD-0102-S means no data. Normalize Chinese ROC 113 and English ROC 114 schemas by semantic aliases. Filter county 新北市 and require source city code 65000000. Validate every age/sex cell against the expected 0-99 plus 100+ grid, allowing only the measured ROC 113 missing male 100+ cell; do not impute it. Store age 0-99 as integer single-age intervals and 100 as (100,NULL). Reconcile source and output cell-by-cell, run a three-times-median rate scale guard, and do not sum rates or materialize an 18-35 rate.
